definitions.explanation: Refers to the period of early childhood. Often used in formal or literary contexts when describing someone's upbringing or formative years.

examples.japanese: {幼少|ようしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っていた→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I had been learning piano since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幼少期|ようしょうき}→幼少期：21168_youshouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: He spent his early childhood overseas.

examples.japanese: {幼少|ようしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Experiences from early childhood had a great influence on the rest of his life.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the set phrase {幼少|ようしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ} (in one's childhood) or as ⟦{幼少期|ようしょうき}→幼少期：21168_youshouki⟧ (childhood period). Has a formal, slightly literary tone compared to the more casual ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}. Often used in biographies, interviews, and written narratives.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幼少|ようしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: in one's childhood
- ⟦{幼少期|ようしょうき}→幼少期：21168_youshouki⟧: childhood period
- {幼少|ようしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since childhood
